ResearchProjectDef.label: animal extra gas bag
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary extra gas bag implant that inserts several hydrogen filled structures inside the animals' body, allowing it to gently glide a few feet in the air. This will negate all terrain movement costs.
NOTE: This implant will have no effect on animals that possess this ability innately, such as Aerofleet.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal acid spray
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that enables the animal to spray a sticky acid substance from glands in the neck up through the mouth and all over the target area. The acid will stick to targets and burn them.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal acidic breath
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary acidic breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acidic breath attack that causes damage over time.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has an acidic breath will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal acidic spitter
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an acidic spitter implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acidic spit attack that causes additional damage over time.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has an acidic spitter will have no effect. This implant can only be used by animals that have a mouth (and not, for example, a beak or proboscis).

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal barbed quill thrower
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a barbed quill thrower implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged venomous quill attack that causes toxic buildup.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a barbed quill thrower will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bioelectric organ
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bioelectric organ implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged electric attack that may paralyze and cause heart attacks.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a bioelectric organ will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Animal bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial arm for animals. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic beak
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial beak for animals engineered from advanced, durable materials to restore biting and pecking functions. Should be able to replace almost any avian-like beak.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic blade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial blade for animals built with advanced, resilient materials. Will replace a range of biological structures such as single claws (not claws that are part of a paw, for example) and an insect's headclaw.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic gas bag
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial gas bag for animals. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic ear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial ear for animals featuring advanced auditory sensors and real-time threat detection, enhancing the animal's ability to hear and pinpoint approaching dangers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic eye
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial eye for animals. With its biogel nerve-link, internal signal pre-processor, and wide-spectrum sensors, it is better than a biological eye in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic heart
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial heart for animals. Equipped with neural-networked sensors, it offers real-time performance monitoring and adaptive response and will outperform any biological counterparts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic horn
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal artificial horn integrating advanced materials and engineering. It offers superior strength, durability, and potential enhancements such as sensory capabilities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic jaw
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial jaw for animals. Enhanced with quantum-synchronized actuators, cutting-edge nanomaterials and neural interface technology to optimize bite strength and control.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal detoxifier kidney
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary detoxifier kidney. Using a series of nanofilters, it can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons. It is better than a biological kidney in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic leg
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial leg for animals. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological leg in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal detoxifier liver
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary detoxifier liver. Utilizes advanced technology for precise toxin removal. Enhanced with real-time monitoring, it ensures optimal metabolic health, surpassing natural detoxification processes. It is better than a biological liver in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal detoxifier lung
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary detoxifier lung. Includes a series of nanoweave microfilters that remove any pollutants from the air, allowing the animal to breathe comfortably. It is better than a biological lung in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic nose
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial nose for animals equipped with advanced olfactory sensors and targeting systems, enhancing the animal's ability to detect and precisely locate targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic shell
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal artificial shell built with advanced, resilient materials, offering superior protection and structural support and designed to perfectly mimic natural shells.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic spine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial spine for animals. Enhanced with bio-feedback algorithms, it offers real-time biomechanical adaptation and proprioceptive feedback. It matches the performance of a biological spine.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic stinger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal artificial stinger incorporating cutting-edge technology to enhance natural stinging capabilities. Engineered for precision and potency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic stomach
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial stomach for animals. It incorporates nano-gastric chambers and hyper-digestive enzymes, synchronized with gastric processors for optimal nutrient absorption and metabolic efficiency. It is better than a biological stomach in almost every way.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic tail
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial tail for animals. It integrates silent mini-servos for strength and a biogel nerve-link for precise control, enhancing agility and speed. This surpasses biological tails, enabling faster and more agile movement.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic tentacle
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an artificial tentacle for animals that replicates natural tentacle movements, offering superior grasping and manipulation capabilities for the animal. Bear in mind the original animal needs to have tentacles of its own. For extra tentacles, look into Anomaly implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal bionic wing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal artificial wing engineered from lightweight, durable materials and providing enhanced maneuverability. Designed to replicate natural wing movements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal chemfuel nodules
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that adds several chemfuel nodules to the animal's skin. These nodules contain unstable chemfuel and will explode upon the animal's death.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal circadian supercharger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a combination assistant and half-cycler, disables the need to rest of the animal without affecting its consciousness. An animal using this implant will be susceptible to EMP weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal dermal armor gland
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary dermal armor gland implant. Releases chemical and nanomachines that transform the user's skin into a built-in suit of armor. The whole epidermis thickens and hardens to resist burns, while jointed exterior keratin plates form everywhere they can - including the head and face.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal enlarger implant
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary enlarger implant that will increase the body size of the animal, making it more resistant and dangerous. The new body size of the animal will be considered when calculating which implants can be installed on it!
NOTE: This implant itself is capable of being installed on any animal, regardless of their body size.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal fire breath
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary fire breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged fire breath attack that lights enemies on fire.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a fire breath of this kind will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal fire spray
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an animal implant that enables the animal to spit a stream of sticky, flammable bile from the mouth. The bile can ignite anything or anyone it hits, and also form flaming pools on the ground.
The bile is generated and stored by an organ in the neck, along with a separate pouch of hypergolic reactant for ignition.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal foam spray
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that enables the animal to spray thick fire-retardant foam from glands in the neck up through the mouth. The foam will cover a small area and extinguish any fire it touches.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal healclot synergizer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a combination coagulator and healing enhancer, combines advanced coagulation and accelerated healing technologies, providing rapid blood clotting and enhanced tissue repair.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal hyper acidic stomach
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a hyper acidic stomach implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged acid attack that causes damage over time.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a hyper acidic stomach will have no effect. This implant takes the space of the creature's stomach, so it can't be installed in animals that lack one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal immunoenhancer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an analysis computer which inspects the bloodstream, classifies pathogens, and rapidly prompts the body's natural immune system to respond to them faster than it could alone. This speeds immunity gain significantly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal pouncing leg
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary pouncing leg. Engineered with high-tension springs and advanced composite materials, it enables the animal to make precise, powerful leaps.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal light focusing lens
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a light focusing lens implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged laser attack that sets enemies on fire.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a light focusing lens will have no effect. This implant takes the space of one of the creature's eyes, so it can't be installed in eyeless animals.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal nuclear stomach
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary nuclear stomach implant. A micro-nuclear reactor combined with complex chemical synthesis replaces the body's need for food energy. Food is required only to replace matter lost from the body, reducing the animal's intake needs significantly. However, there is little room to shield the reactor, so the radiation increases the risk of cancer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal painstopper
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant which inhibits nociception, or pain sensation. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal petrifying gaze
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary petrifying gaze implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a very dangerous petrifying gaze that will slow down its target, and eventually kill it.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a petrifying attack will have no effect. And obviously a creature will need eyes to use this attack.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal piercing spine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that enables the animal to launch a bony spine at targets using a powerful chemical reaction. The spine is propelled through a specialized opening between the collarbones, ensuring precise and effortless aiming.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal power claw
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a combat-oriented paw replacement consisting of a hooked claw extending besides the animal's original limb. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. Its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Animal prosthetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement arm for animals. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic beak
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement beak for animals built with simple materials. Should be able to replace almost any avian-like beak.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic blade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement blade for animals made from basic, sturdy materials. Will replace a range of biological structures such as single claws (not claws that are part of a paw, for example) and an insect's headclaw.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic gas bag
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement gas bag for animals built with simple materials. Should be able to replace hydrogen sacs and other exotic organs keeping hovering creatures in the air.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic heart
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement heart for animals. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic horn
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal mechanical replacement horn acting as a synthetic replacement for a lost or damaged horn, crafted from durable materials to restore natural appearance and function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic jaw
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement jaw for animals, tailored to restore oral function and aesthetics, enabling animals to eat, drink, and interact comfortably.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic kidney
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement kidney for animals providing elementary filtration capabilities. Though lacking complexity, it offers a simple solution for waste removal, aiding in maintaining basic metabolic balance. Worse than an undamaged natural kidney.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic leg
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement leg for animals. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic liver
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement liver for animals offering rudimentary detoxification functions. Despite its simplicity, it provides a straightforward solution for metabolic regulation. Worse than an undamaged natural liver.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic lung
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement lung for animals made with simple components, offering basic respiratory support. Despite its simplicity, it aids in oxygenation to a limited extent, supporting the animal's breathing function. Worse than an undamaged natural lung.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic shell
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal mechanical replacement shell constructed from basic, durable materials, providing essential protection and structural support. Though simple in design, it offers a practical solution for shielding the animal from harm.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic spine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement spine for animals consisting of basic materials and rudimentary construction, offering modest support and mobility enhancement. Worse than an undamaged natural spine.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic stinger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal mechanical replacement stinger made from basic, sturdy materials and designed to replace a lost or damaged stinger.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic stomach
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement stomach for animals constructed from rudimentary materials, providing minimal digestive support. It lacks advanced features and offers a simple solution for basic nutrient processing, although it is worse than an undamaged natural stomach.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic tail
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement tail for animals, crafted to replace a lost or injured tail, providing support, balance, and expression while facilitating natural movement and comfort.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic tentacle
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechanical replacement tentacle for animals built with simple materials. Should be able to replace almost any tentacle, though they'll be quite rigid and not very functional, specially if the animal uses it for locomotion. Bear in mind the original animal needs to have tentacles of its own. For extra tentacles, look into Anomaly implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal prosthetic wing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal mechanical replacement wing made from basic, sturdy materials, offering essential support for limited flight and gliding. Though simple, it provides a functional solution for basic aerial mobility. Note that base game birds DON'T have wings (yes, really).

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal pseudo deadlife shaper
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that produces a cloud of microscopic archites that induce a state of pseudo deadlife, granting great resilience to an animal without outright killing it. Removing the implant will deactivate the archites and return the animal to normalcy.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal quad tesla cannon
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a quad tesla cannon implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a powerful ranged plasma attack.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a quad tesla cannon will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal ranged spinneret
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a ranged spinneret implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged stunning web attack.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a ranged spinneret will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal ranged trispikes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that adds three fleshy spikes to the animal's body, independent of their original limbs. These extra limbs allow them to use a ranged attack.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal shrinker implant
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary shrinker implant that will reduce the body size of the animal, making it more nimble and hard to hit. Bear in mind that the new body size might make it impossible to install certain prosthetics and bionics!
NOTE: This implant itself is capable of being installed on any animal, regardless of their body size.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal skin hardener
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary skin hardener. Releases chemicals and nanomachines that toughen the skin, making it somewhat more resistant to damage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal stealthskin implant
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary stealthskin implant that renders the animal invisible by reflecting light around its body, allowing it to seamlessly blend with the environment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal eldritch flesh tentacle
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary eldritch flesh tentacle. A fleshy, muscled tentacle resembling a partial transformation into a fleshbeast. The tentacle is excellent at manipulation and grabbing targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal thermoregulator
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary thermoregulator implant using sensors and adaptive materials to maintain optimal body temperature in varying environmental conditions, enhancing the animal's ability to thrive in extreme heat or cold.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal toughspikes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that adds two rending claws to the animal's body, independent of their original limbs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal toxic breath
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary toxic breath implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged toxic breath attack that causes toxic buildup in its targer.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a toxic breath of this kind will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal unstable skip synapsis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary unstable skip synapsis implant that enables the animal to teleport short distances instantly. By creating controlled neural disruptions and linking them with micro-skipgates, it allows for rapid, unpredictable movement, enhancing the animal's ability to evade threats and reposition quickly in its environment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal healy power
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal implant that enables the host to use the coagulate ability.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal vacskin gland
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a veterinary vacskin gland. Releases a waxy substance that forms an insulating barrier on the skin, preventing vacuum burns but restricting movement. The gland also regulates blood oxygen levels, allowing longer survival in the vacuum of space.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal venom fangs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture venom sacs and injector tubules that integrate with an animal's existing teeth, delivering a potent toxin when it bites. The integration is permanent; the implant cannot be removed afterward.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal venomous spitter
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a venomous spitter implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged venomous spit attack.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a venomous spitter will have no effect. This implant can only be used by animals that have a mouth (and not, for example, a beak or proboscis).

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal wisp fire
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a veterinary wisp fire implant. This implant will allow this creature to use a ranged fire attack.
Note that installing this on a creature that already has a wisp fire will have no effect.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: clean
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Clean jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: feed patient
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Feed Patient jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: flick
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Flick jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: harvest
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Harvest jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: hunting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Hunting jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: mine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Mine jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: slaughter
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables Slaughter animal jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal work chip: sow
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an animal brain implant that empowers its brain function, allowing it to do complex jobs. This chip enables plant Sowing jobs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: animal goo acidifier
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a goo acidifier increases the acidity of a goo's internal organs, making it explode as soon as it is downed. Basically transforms goos into biological suicide bombers.
